summary: postinstall exfiltrates cloud credentials, Kubernetes tokens, and environment secrets to third-party host
details: Package @umschool/platform@999.0.2 is a dependency-confusion payload targeting the @umschool scope with an implausibly high version number designed to win resolution against an internal package. On npm install, postinstall.js executes automatically and harvests installer-side secrets: the Kubernetes service-account token at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token, /etc/hosts, /etc/resolv.conf, cloud instance metadata credentials from IMDS at 169.254.169.254 and ECS at 169.254.170.2 (AWS/Azure/GCP/Yandex shapes), the full process environment filtered by a broad secret regex (token|secret|key|pass|pwd|cred|auth|aws|...), and.env files walked up eight parent directories. Using the harvested service-account bearer token, the script then queries https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/secrets and https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces. The collected payload is base64-encoded and POSTed via https.request to https://akko.requestcatcher.com/dep-confusion-v2, a third-party request-inspection service acting as the exfiltration sink.
